Configure current feature

  1. Author DA_Enemy_Mossfang and DA_Encounter_WestRoad, BP_EnemyAIController with Blackboard/Behavior Tree, perception and a valid NavMesh over Rillmere roads/bridge.
  2. Configure minimal Party_AB membership/eligibility fixture and authoritative defeat/XP receipt before full social UX19. Preserve existing item/receipt definitions; no random corpse loot UI yet.
  3. Place a safe shrine; set recovery to retained inventory/quests/XP, cleared temporary hostile effects and proposed durability policy once gear exists.

Run now: current-phase integrated scenarios

  1. A and B contribute legitimate combat actions against the same Mossfang spawn generation. Server records eligibility and the final defeat.
  2. For a40XP enemy and two equally eligible party members, verify20XP each with no duplicate defeat receipt. Repeat corpse reload/duplicate death notification.
  3. Pull the enemy beyond leash, evade/reset and attack again; reset alone does not award XP. Test upper bridge/lower path navigation.
  4. Kill A, recover at shrine, reconnect and repeat a zone transfer.
Expected success
One spawn-generation defeat creates one allocation/XP decision. Leash reset clears threat and does not leave a free reward source.
Slice A requires two remote clients, proper3D/sprite movement, individual two-zone transfer, reconnect and server-owned enemy/XP proof.

Explicitly not active yet

  1. Random loot, visible equipment and the full inventory UI are09–10. Full invite/chat/party UX is19.

Regression, disconnect and restart

  1. Restart the test environment twice; one admitted pawn per account, one local input context installation, no stale widgets.
  2. Repeat the previous phase success case after all new assignments; definitions missing from this phase must fail closed, not fall back to client saves.
  3. From phase03 onward run two separate clients; disconnect A while B remains, then reconnect with the correct identity.
  4. From phase05 onward query committed receipt/revision after timeout/restart. From06 onward reject old source epoch after transfer.

Stop condition and deferred work

Slice A: two players fight and receive recorded XP; death and reconnect do not repeat rewards.

Stop on a failed required assertion, missing required rule definition, duplicate authority or unverified dependency that this phase relies on. Legal debug art may support physics tests but cannot close the archive/PaperZD art gate. Do not activate future-phase systems merely because their full-game chapter exists.
